origin.description: Build a gnlsStruct model structure from optional correlation and variance components.
origin.details: NULL components are dropped. The class vector is gnlsStruct, glsStruct and modelStruct.
origin.example:
.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(nlme))
fm <- gnlsStruct(corStruct = corAR1(0.2, form = ~ 1 | Mare))
print(names(fm))
print(class(fm))
print(length(fm))

translation.description: Build a GnlsStruct holding the non-None components in order.

arguments.name: corStruct
arguments.text: a correlation structure object or None

arguments.name: varStruct
arguments.text: a variance function object or None

translation.details: Initialize.gnlsStruct is not translated yet; it depends on the component Initialize methods.
translation.value: A GnlsStruct with components, names, corStruct, varStruct, classes, and len.
translation.example:
from nlme.corar1 import corAR1
from nlme.gnlsstruct import gnlsStruct

fm = gnlsStruct(corStruct=corAR1(0.2, form="~ 1 | Mare"))
print(fm.names)
print(fm.classes)
print(len(fm))
